page: Microsoft Azure DC16es_v5 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEV5 server family. Powered by an Intel processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. The underlying virtualization is managed by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external volumes. It is premium storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance persistent disks. There are no integrated GPUs, and the configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the DC16es_v5 offers a dedicated resource profile tailored for workloads that rely on externalized storage architectures rather than local ephemeral disks. This design reduces local hardware overhead while maintaining dedicated compute and memory resources. It is suitable for memory-optimized workloads, database hosting, enterprise applications, and structured data processing.
